sources.title: lvzhou-mindnlp/albert-xlarge-v2 — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: ALBERT-xlarge-v2 for MindNLP This repository contains the ALBERT-xlarge-v2 model, adapted for use with the MindNLP library and the Huawei MindSpore framework. ALBERT (A Lite BERT) incorporates two parameter-reduction techniques—factorised embedding parameterisation and cross-layer parameter sharing—to overcome the memory limitations often associated with scaling transformer architectures.
